newsitem.title: UK: Barr & Wallace to sell leisure division.
newsitem.headline: Barr & Wallace to sell leisure division.

text.p: Britain's Barr & Wallace Arnold Trust Plc said on Friday it was planning to sell its leisure division to Wallace Arnold Group Ltd, a management buy-out vehicle backed by investment capital group 3I for 41.8 million stg.
The leisure division was involved in the sale and operation of inclusive coach holidays in the United Kingdom and Europe under brand names Wallace Arnold and Caledonian.
The company said it was planning to pay a special dividend of 17.9 million stg equivalent to 120 pence per share.
The company was also considering returning further cash to shareholders and would seek approval to buy-back up to 15 percent of the company's ordinary shares.
The group's core business, post-disposal, would comprise sale of new cars through franchised dealerships of Ford, Vauxhall and Peugeot.
The company's name will be changed to Trust Motor Group Plc, it said.
By 0730 GMT, the company's share price was marked upwards to 377-1/2 pence from Thursday's closing of 309 1/2p.
